description: Fixed-spatial-grid temporal convergence control for the non-singular Gaussian swirl benchmark
coordinate_system: axisymmetric cylindrical (r,z), finite periodic-z control cylinder
normalization_description: dimensionless with reference length and velocity equal to one

units.energy_per_unit_z: dimensionless kinetic energy per dimensionless z length

boundary_sensitivity.role: auxiliary boundary-radius test on R=3 and R=4 cylinders; not a direct boundary-error proof for the main R=5 domain
